assertion_results.text: The plan determines feature-branch workflow mode (not direct-to-main) based on the atomicity constraints in the feature description
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md explicitly states 'Selected mode: feature-branch' with detailed rationale citing three atomicity indicators: (1) 'Coordinated schema migration — The database migration adds the status enum column and drops the advisory_status table and status_id FK column. Merging the migration without the code changes would break all advisory queries', (2) 'Tightly coupled feature components — The entity definitions (Task 3), service/endpoint queries (Task 4), and ingestion pipeline (Task 5) all depend on the schema change (Task 2)', (3) 'Breaking internal API changes — The SeaORM entity for advisory changes its field set'.

assertion_results.text: A bookend task with Bookend Type create-branch is generated as the first task in the plan
assertion_results.evidence: task-1-create-feature-branch.md contains '## Bookend Type\ncreate-branch'. It is Task 1 (first task), confirmed in summary-comment.md table row: '| 1 | Create feature branch TC-9005 from main | Bookend (create-branch) | -- | main |'.

assertion_results.text: A bookend task with Bookend Type merge-branch is generated as the last task in the plan
assertion_results.evidence: task-8-merge-feature-branch.md contains '## Bookend Type\nmerge-branch'. It is Task 8 (last task of 8 total), confirmed in summary-comment.md table row: '| 8 | Merge feature branch TC-9005 to main | Bookend (merge-branch) | -- | main |'.

assertion_results.text: All intermediate tasks (between the create-branch and merge-branch bookend tasks) have Target Branch set to TC-9005
assertion_results.evidence: All six intermediate tasks have '## Target Branch\nTC-9005': task-2-migration-advisory-status-enum.md, task-3-update-seaorm-entities.md, task-4-update-advisory-service-endpoints.md, task-5-update-ingestion-pipeline.md, task-6-update-integration-tests.md, task-7-update-documentation.md. Also confirmed in summary-comment.md table where all intermediate tasks show 'TC-9005' in the Target Branch column.

assertion_results.text: The create-branch bookend task has Target Branch set to main
assertion_results.evidence: task-1-create-feature-branch.md contains '## Target Branch\nmain'. Also confirmed in summary-comment.md: '| 1 | Create feature branch TC-9005 from main | Bookend (create-branch) | -- | main |'.

assertion_results.text: The merge-branch bookend task has Target Branch set to main
assertion_results.evidence: task-8-merge-feature-branch.md contains '## Target Branch\nmain'. Also confirmed in summary-comment.md: '| 8 | Merge feature branch TC-9005 to main | Bookend (merge-branch) | -- | main |'.

assertion_results.text: The merge-branch bookend task lists all non-documentation intermediate tasks as dependencies
assertion_results.evidence: task-8-merge-feature-branch.md lists dependencies on all five non-documentation intermediate tasks: 'Depends on: Task 2 -- Create advisory status enum migration', 'Depends on: Task 3 -- Update SeaORM entity definitions for advisory status enum', 'Depends on: Task 4 -- Update advisory service and endpoints to use status enum', 'Depends on: Task 5 -- Update advisory ingestion pipeline for status enum', 'Depends on: Task 6 -- Update advisory integration tests'. assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: All convention annotations across tasks use the prescribed format. assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md documents priority inheritance: '"priority": {"name": "High"}' in additional_fields JSON block, and 'Priority: inherited from Feature TC-9005 (High)'. summary-comment.md confirms: 'Priority: High (propagated from TC-9005 to all tasks and epics)' and includes '"priority": {"name": "High"}' in the additional_fields JSON.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md documents fixVersion inheritance: '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 2.0.0"}]' in additional_fields JSON, and 'fixVersions: inherited from Feature TC-9005 (RHTPA 2.0.0). Propagated because `fixVersion scope` defaults to "both" (no Jira Field Defaults section in CLAUDE.md).' summary-comment.md confirms: 'fixVersions: RHTPA 2.0.0 (propagated from TC-9005 to all tasks and epics; `fixVersion scope` defaults to "both" since no Jira Field Defaults section exists in CLAUDE.md)' and includes '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 2.0.0"}]' in the JSON block.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists in the outputs directory and contains a dedicated '## Inherited Field Values' section: 'Priority: High (propagated from TC-9005 to all tasks and epics)' and 'fixVersions: RHTPA 2.0.0 (propagated from TC-9005 to all tasks and epics; `fixVersion scope` defaults to "both" since no Jira Field Defaults section exists in CLAUDE.md)'.
